{"description":"From assay mimid-1wgh.44.6 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mls-semiprivatemessage-08.txt. Posting needs Mark's OK (repo github.com/rohanmahy/mls-semiprivatemessage).

1. external_receivers: extension or component? §1 L123-124 and §3 L150 call it a 'GroupContext extension'; §5.2 L418 registers an 'MLS Component Type' but with the Extension Types template ('Message(s): GC', L427). Suggested 0x0007 is free as a component (Rohan's coordination gist lists component 0x0007 external_receivers) but collides as an extension type with mls-extensions-11 supported_wire_formats (0x0007 suggested, -11 txt L1620). The two choices differ in how the list changes (AppDataUpdate vs GroupContextExtensions; -11 §4.7).
2. §3.3 L382-385: the external receiver 'verifies that the framed_content_tbs_hash is correct' unconditionally but checks the signature only 'if [it] has a copy of the GroupContext'. FramedContentTBS includes the GroupContext for a member sender (RFC 9420 §6.1), so the hash cannot be checked without it either.
3. §3.3 L379 'Using the nonce and sender_leaf_node' should be sender_leaf_index (the field of PerMessageKeyAndNonces, L233); L381 'the member decrypts' in the external-receiver section should be 'the external receiver'.
4. §3.1 names: key_and_nonces (L244, L253) vs keys_and_nonces (L251) vs encrypted_key_and_nonces (L247) vs encrypted_keys_and_nonces (L257, L267).
5. §3.1 L236 partial_context_hash = hash(sender_leaf_index || nonce): the byte encoding of the concatenation (uint32 big-endian? nonce with or without its length?) is not stated.
6. L344 MLSMessage arm 'mls_semiprivate_message_' has a stray trailing underscore.
7. Reference is mls-extensions-10 (L453-458); -11 is current. §4 is TODO (L404).

8. A room cannot turn SemiPrivateMessage on without first negotiating
   the external_receivers component: the group must list 0x0007 in
   app_components and every member leaf must declare support for it
   (mls-extensions-11 §5). The draft says how to send and read a
   SemiPrivateMessage and never says the component has to be negotiated
   before the room can use it, nor in what order.
9. §3.1 framed_content_tbs_hash = hash(FramedContentTBS): RFC 9420 §6.1
   FramedContentTBS has a wire_format field, and the draft does not say
   whether it holds mls_semiprivate_message or mls_private_message. It
   has to be the former, or a SemiPrivateMessage and a PrivateMessage
   over the same FramedContent would have the same signature and either
   could be repackaged as the other, defeating required_wire_formats.
10. An external receiver must rebuild FramedContent to recompute that
   hash, and FramedContent carries the sender. The frame does not give
   it in the clear, and an external receiver has no key for the
   SenderData that would. PerMessageKeyAndNonces.sender_leaf_index is
   what fills the gap; §3.3 mentions it only as an input to
   partial_context_hash. Worth saying that it is also how an external
   receiver learns the sender."}

{"description":"From assay mimid-1wgh.44.6 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mls-semiprivatemessage-08.txt. Posting needs Mark's OK (repo github.com/rohanmahy/mls-semiprivatemessage).

1. external_receivers: extension or component? §1 L123-124 and §3 L150 call it a 'GroupContext extension'; §5.2 L418 registers an 'MLS Component Type' but with the Extension Types template ('Message(s): GC', L427). Suggested 0x0007 is free as a component (Rohan's coordination gist lists component 0x0007 external_receivers) but collides as an extension type with mls-extensions-11 supported_wire_formats (0x0007 suggested, -11 txt L1620). The two choices differ in how the list changes (AppDataUpdate vs GroupContextExtensions; -11 §4.7).
2. §3.3 L382-385: the external receiver 'verifies that the framed_content_tbs_hash is correct' unconditionally but checks the signature only 'if [it] has a copy of the GroupContext'. FramedContentTBS includes the GroupContext for a member sender (RFC 9420 §6.1), so the hash cannot be checked without it either.
3. §3.3 L379 'Using the nonce and sender_leaf_node' should be sender_leaf_index (the field of PerMessageKeyAndNonces, L233); L381 'the member decrypts' in the external-receiver section should be 'the external receiver'.
4. §3.1 names: key_and_nonces (L244, L253) vs keys_and_nonces (L251) vs encrypted_key_and_nonces (L247) vs encrypted_keys_and_nonces (L257, L267).
5. §3.1 L236 partial_context_hash = hash(sender_leaf_index || nonce): the byte encoding of the concatenation (uint32 big-endian? nonce with or without its length?) is not stated.
6. L344 MLSMessage arm 'mls_semiprivate_message_' has a stray trailing underscore.
7. Reference is mls-extensions-10 (L453-458); -11 is current. §4 is TODO (L404).

8. A room cannot turn SemiPrivateMessage on without first negotiating
   the external_receivers component: the group must list 0x0007 in
   app_components and every member leaf must declare support for it
   (mls-extensions-11 §5). The draft says how to send and read a
   SemiPrivateMessage and never says the component has to be negotiated
   before the room can use it, nor in what order.
9. §3.1 framed_content_tbs_hash = hash(FramedContentTBS): RFC 9420 §6.1
   FramedContentTBS has a wire_format field, and the draft does not say
   whether it holds mls_semiprivate_message or mls_private_message. It
   has to be the former, or a SemiPrivateMessage and a PrivateMessage
   over the same FramedContent would have the same signature and either
   could be repackaged as the other, defeating required_wire_formats.
10. An external receiver must rebuild FramedContent to recompute that
   hash, and FramedContent carries the sender. The frame does not give
   it in the clear, and an external receiver has no key for the
   SenderData that would. PerMessageKeyAndNonces.sender_leaf_index is
   what fills the gap; §3.3 mentions it only as an input to
   partial_context_hash. Worth saying that it is also how an external
   receiver learns the sender.
11. §3 L173-179 lists two conditions for using SemiPrivateMessage (the
   format in required_wire_formats, an entry in external_receivers) and
   omits a third that RFC 9420 imposes: every leaf must advertise
   extension type 0x0008, or the GroupContext cannot carry
   required_wire_formats at all. Found by a group being refused with
   InsufficientCapabilities. Same kind of omission as item 8."}
